import {test,expect,beforeAll,beforeEach,afterEach,afterAll} from 'vitest'
import {appendFileSync} from 'node:fs'
const trace = value => appendFileSync('lifecycle.log', value + '\n')
beforeAll(() => trace('before-all'))
beforeEach(() => trace('before-each'))
afterEach(() => trace('after-each'))
afterAll(() => trace('after-all'))
test('production zero', () => {
  trace('body:zero')
  expect(process.env.NODE_ENV).toBe('production')
  const actual = 3
  expect(actual).toBe(3)
})

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') throw new Error('actual production JSX profile required')
